instruction: Change the line spacing of all document paragraphs to 1.5.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if all paragraphs have 1.5 line spacing, 0.0 otherwise
